title: Hollow Drift Choir
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A mid-register sawtooth pad with white noise sculpted into its body, voiced through cycling vowels for a hollow, breathing choir character. Over 24 cycles the noise blend swells, a band-pass sweep opens, and twin pan LFOs drift the texture across the stereo field so it never settles.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  note("<c3 eb3 g3 <bb2 f3>>/2").s("sawtooth")
    .noise(sine.slow(16).range(0.05, 0.45))
    .vowel("<a o u e>/3")
    .bpf(sine.slow(24).range(350, 2600)).resonance(sine.slow(19).range(6, 16)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(2).lpattack(0.05).lpdecay(0.4)
    .vib("<3 4 6>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.1, 0.8))
    .attack(0.08).decay(0.4).sustain(0.7).release(0.3)
    .shape(sine.slow(29).range(0.1, 0.35)).crush("<16 12 10>/16")
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.15, 0.85))
    .off(1/4, x => x.add(note(7)).pan(tri.slow(11).range(0.85, 0.15)).gain(0.3).room(0.6))
    .room(sine.slow(32).range(0.3, 0.7)).gain(0.8)
)
